notes.title: WOFG August 8th 2024 - The Goblin Menu Update
notes.notes:
Hello Goblin Gang! We’ve been hard at work getting more features ready as we work towards our demo for Next Fest in October. Here’s what’s changed in this update: 

New Features
Goblin menu

 Open the goblin menu by pressing select (or tab, on mouse and keyboard). You can do all sorts of fun stuff with this menu.
 Customize your goblin! We have a cosmetics system. Show off your goblin style with a bunch of cosmetic options in customizable colors.
 Respawn your goblin at any checkpoint you’ve previously activated.
 See a list of all power cogs in the scene, and which ones you’ve collected.
 Read the tutorial pages any time you want. 
  

Control stuff

 Rebindable Controls - You can rebind gameplay controls from the settings menu, this is currently tied to your player profile, but will soon be tied to your player goblin. To prevent players from softlocking themselves you can’t rebind UI controls.
 Dynamic input prompts - Input prompts should now update to reflect the correct controls. This means keyboard players should get keyboard prompts. These should also update if controls are rebound.


IK stuff

 Added IK to the goblins hands while grabbing. This makes the goblins reach for the nearest object while grabbing. This makes it much easier to grab stuff in mid air.  
 Added some look at IK to goblin NPC behaviors. It just makes them look a bit more lively.


Bug Fixes

 Fixed a bug where force respawning while in the sludge would cause an “anti-gravity” effect. 
 Fixed a bug that sometimes caused goblins to trip while sprinting on flat ground. 


The bad news

 We have made the decision to reduce the number of supported players from four to two. There are a few reasons for this. The main one is performance- rendering is our biggest bottle neck and we want the game to be able to run well even on older PCs.   
 This might be disappointing to you, it is for us, but we feel it's best for the game to make this decision early. 
 We are fully committed to supporting two player split-screen. We love couch co-op games and it’s very important to us that we are able to play WOFG! together.


I think that’s all for now. Thanks again for participating in the open playtest. Until next time: Watch Out for Goblins!

notes.title: July 3rd Update Notes
notes.notes:
I see at least a few of you have a lot of playtime in the current playtest build. That’s awesome. I’ve included all three in development maps in this new update. Nothing is finished, but it should give you plenty of new content to play with.

New Features:

 Racetrack map is back- this is where I test all my new features.
 The Skrimble Isles map is here to- plan is this map will eventually become our demo level.
 New Goblin NPC behaviors. They talk to you now, and feel much more lively overall. 
 New sprint system. Hold X and forward to dash, let go and you’ll keep sprinting. Be careful as dashing consumes stamina. Don’t knock yourself out. 
 New stamina/health UI. 
 Bunch of new sound FX.
 Giant flies that will try to ram you into the sludge. The model is a prototype and they have no SFX yet.


Bug Fixes:

 Fixed the goblin repining bugs that were “pulling” the goblin out of place after landing on slopes.
 Goblins are now correctly removed from minigame trackers after the minigame ends. 
 Fixed most respawning bugs. Goblins shouldn’t be spawning underground. At least I hope not. 
 Fixed a bug on rejoining where the first player goblin would ignore gravity.
 Other small bug fixes.


Things I didn’t get around to fixing (but are still on the list):

 Jump and punch UI are still buggy as anything. 
 Player prompts are still all for a gamepad. Keyboard is supported, but you have to figure out the buttons on your own. XD
 Toggling in and out of the sprint still causes the camera to jumpcut. It’s less noticeable now that the sprint mechanics have changed but I still want to clean it up at some point. 


Thank you so much for playtesting. Your feedback is helping us make WOFG! The best game it can be. If you notice anything you want to let us know about you can post it to the Steam community boards here:
 WOFG! Playtest Steam Community 
We also have a modest discord server if you’d like to chat with us devs directly: 
 SQYD.studio Discord Server 
Until next time remember to Watch Out for Goblins!

notes.title: WOFG! Playtest Changelog 0.2
notes.notes:
Added tutorial area and pages to teach players how to play.
 Changes to physics settings to better stabilize goblin ragdolls.
 Bug fixes for bugs caused by re-spawning goblins. 
 More sound effects and improvements to the SFX system for split-screen multiplayer.
 Added prompts to activate minigames in multiplayer. Minigames no longer require all goblins to gather in one place before they can start. 
 New background music.
 Smaller performance optimizations and bug fixes.
